text:
nina_sales: FYI prospect Novus wants a 10-day POC. Must-haves: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning + deprovisioning, group->role mapping, domain verification for multiple shared domains, and a simple Hosted vs Dedicated POC pricing comparison. Can we cover this next week?

tom_solutions: Short answer: yes. Clarify if they need EU-only data or full Private (VPC). Hosted can be region-pinned to EU which often satisfies legal for POC.

ivy_eng: Throughput: they estimate ~1k MAU and 80 r/s peaks. Dedicated advised for steady latencies; Hosted acceptable with throttles for POC if they accept occasional higher p95. SCIM notes: we provide delta sync and a Bulk endpoint for initial import. Our default SCIM throttle is 5 req/s with 429 backoff; we suggest bulk or staging endpoint for large imports.

ivy_eng: SCIM sample PATCH we normally give partners:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Content-Type: application/json

{"operations":[{"op":"replace","value":{"active":false}}]}
```

soren_security: Security flags: we require signed SAML responses (SHA256) and recommend encrypted attributes if they care about PII. If they insist on Private we need to confirm KMS choice (AWS/GCP) and rotate keys policy. I sent the security questionnaire link to them: https://redwood.ai/security-questionnaire — ask to return before kickoff.

nina_sales: Customer prefers Hosted for speed but legal mentioned potential EU residency clause. Also asks: can a single Okta group map to multiple roles? And do we support role precedence/hierarchy?

tom_solutions: Yes on both. A group can map to multiple roles; precedence is explicit numeric priority. We can demo the mapping UI and role precedence in the POC. Tenant-level admin roles and scoped delegated admin exist too.

ivy_eng: For domain proofing: we support TXT verification tokens (e.g., _redwoodverify.example.com). Multiple verified domains can be attached to one tenant. We also support tenant locking to domain+email claim so only claimed domains can sign up.

soren_security: Note SAML logout caveat: SP-initiated logout may not fully invalidate IdP session; recommend documented session TTL and reauth rules. Also confirm whether they need signed logout requests.

provision-bot: provision 1819000007: ephemeral-poc-staging namespace created (2x A10G)  expires in 14d.

nina_sales: Action items:
- Ivy: quick Hosted vs Dedicated pricing table for 10-day window including EU premium and estimated overages.
- Tom: draft POC SOW with success criteria (throughput, latency p95 target, auth flows to exercise).
- Soren: finalize security questionnaire items and recommended SAML metadata config.
- Ivy: include SCIM bulk import instructions and recommended sync window in the SOW.

nina_sales: Can we have quote + SOW + sample SAML metadata + domain verification token by Thu EOD? Customer wants to kick on Mon. Thanks! :pray:
